desc:
Welcome to Mini Cities 2, the ultimate Roblox city builder. 🌆

Start from nothing and progress your way into a mega metropolitan. Keep your citizens happy by building towards their needs. Unlock new buildings inside the development tree. Create the ultimate city.

🛣 Featuring brand new curved and free place roads!
🪨 Manage your cities resources in order to construct more buildings!
🏔 Construct anything you dream of with the new terrain and block editor
🚗 Watch your citizens interact with the world as they drive to their destinations

Made by Destroyer
